scope: Read-only local APK/DEX investigation. No API request made by this reviewer; parent GET/download observations independently checked against saved local evidence.

entrypoints.behavior: Installs ResourceFinder wrapper with VESDK.setEffectResourceFinder. Its createNativeResourceFinder initializes AssetResourceFinder then returns downloadable finder native handle.
Builds downloadable model config with Context.getFilesDir()/effectmodel, two-thread executor, AssetManager, normal app host/config; then installs another ResourceFinder wrapper.
c throws if not initialized; h()Z checks initialization. f->e->d may lazily allocate Java wrapper only.
AlgorithmManager h().i() then realFindResourceUri(0, firstString, nameStr).
Native callback entry delegates to companion and same realFindResourceUri. No long/native handle argument in this String-return callback.
Last String is nameStr; middle String is unused in this implementation. Synchronous cache/built-in lookup, metadata comparison, then success listener. Caller thread retained.

no_lazy_initialization_local_probe.conditions: Read fields and skip when null. Do not call i(), getNativeResourceFinder(), createNativeResourceFinder(), initializer, model downloader or realFindResourceUri merely to export.
no_lazy_initialization_local_probe.important_limit: Even single-argument lookup can open/read DiskLruCache, update journal and, on initial open of a corrupt journal, remove/recreate cache. Passive observation of real returns is the cleanest evidence of active lookup; a deliberate local probe is not proof of active inference.

lookup_contract.canonical_model_key: i.s.d.a.y.n.c(String): keep suffix after last slash; truncate before _v[0-9] when valid, otherwise before .model/_model/.dat, else remaining basename.
lookup_contract.order: AlgorithmModelCache.o(normalizedName) first; otherwise isExactBuiltInResource(originalNameStr) and getBuiltInResourceUrl(originalNameStr).
lookup_contract.disk_result: file:// plus cache file path, through i.s.d.a.y.w.a URL normalization helper.
lookup_contract.asset_result: asset://model/<optional original namespace>/<matching actual model filename>; normalized basename matching allows versioned built-in filenames.
lookup_contract.raw_name_requirement: Preserve original native nameStr separately from normalized basename. Parent native audit sees idream/tt_goodlike passed unchanged through the observed JNI forwarding; Java cache normalization alone does not prove every actual native request name.

critical_side_effect.proof: checkModelMd5 calls i.s.d.a.x.p.d(...,false,mask=2) and g(...,false,mask=4); Kotlin defaults make scheduling flags true. p.c(type,true) enqueues model-list task on cache miss; p.f(type,name,true) enqueues per-model metadata task on miss.
critical_side_effect.other_side_effects: Success/not-found event listeners and telemetry; cache journal reads/initialization; no new native handle required for Java lookup.

cache_contract.sanitization: i.s.d.a.m.g.a$a.d replaces characters outside [a-z0-9_-] with underscore.
cache_contract.payload_location: i.s.d.a.m.g.a$c.a(0) returns cacheDir/key without .0 suffix; nonzero value indexes have dot-index suffix. Payload often ends in _model, not .model.
cache_contract.size_warning: The filename _size component comes from ModelInfo.getType(), not byte length.
cache_contract.local_metadata: i.s.d.a.m.b.o(normalizedName) -> i.s.d.a.t.f: b() filePath, c() filename-derived expected MD5, d() name, e() type-like size token, f() version.
cache_contract.server_metadata: com.ss.ugc.effectplatform.model.algorithm.ModelInfo: getTotalSize()J, getVersion(), getType(), getFile_url(); ExtendedUrlModel.getUri() expected digest, getUrl_list() and getZip_url_list().
cache_contract.download_commit: m/b.r(ModelType,ModelInfo,InputStream) dispatches m/c.writeInputStreamToDisk or writeInputStreamAsZipToDisk, computes/compares MD5 before editor commit. Returned/cache path must be observed; do not invent a path from model name only.
cache_contract.export_receipt: Compute actual byte length, SHA-256 and MD5 from copied payload; record expected MD5 separately and do not substitute type for byte length.

metadata_get_contract.common_generator: i.s.d.a.y.i.a(config,false,true); called via default-mask wrapper b(...,false,false,4,null)
other_common_params: config extra params excluding lx and ly
metadata_get_contract.request_adapter: TTNetEffectNetworkImpl adds os_version query for GET URLs containing &app_version=, then EffectNetworkAPI.doGet(@AddCommonParam=false, maxLength=INT_MAX, relativePath, @QueryMap encode=true).

normal_values.status_reason: Enum TEST ordinal 0 / ONLINE ordinal 1; test preference switches to TEST.

metadata_get_contract.credentials: Static SDK access_key constants exist in APK initialization paths, values deliberately omitted. No key was required for the parent observed successful metadata requests.
metadata_get_contract.auth_scope: EffectNetworkAPI has no explicit Authorization/header argument. Shared TTNet adds BaseSsInterceptor, ClientKeyManager, optional URL/header transforms and RequestVertifyInterceptor. Their existence means the entire app networking cannot be described as unauthenticated even though these particular ordinary GETs succeeded without authentication.

bundled_metadata.note: Recovered base/assets/model has model payloads but no model/resources.json or model/effect_local_config.json file in the observed asset inventory. The DEX supports these optional files. Supplied selected material configs identify main model names without proving a packaged download URL/MD5 for them.

assigned_model_names.direct_call_search: All classes*.dex containing the target descriptor were disassembled and invoke references inspected. Only ModelnamesAssigner own public wrappers invoke its native methods; no direct Java external caller found.
assigned_model_names.limit: Does not exclude reflection or native-internal remapping.

limits: No on-device model lookup/inference run in this review.
Downloaded current model version may differ from a device existing cached version; passive exporter hashes are still needed.
Model availability does not establish input tensor, output tensor, model interpreter or high-precision beauty compatibility.
Raw disassembly/decompiled files are local-only evidence and may contain APK static SDK constants; do not publish the whole audit directory.
